name: clickup
description: Access ClickUp workspaces, spaces, folders, lists, tasks and comments via the myHub-hosted ClickUp MCP gateway — browse your workspace structure, list and filter tasks, create and update tasks, and read or add comments.

connection.instructions: Click Connect and sign in to your ClickUp account, then pick the Workspace(s) to authorize. Your session is managed automatically — no manual token copying needed.
